experiment_data.hypothesis: PI05 + ACR-VLA on Libero-Object with adaptive_conformal_crm at conformal_threshold=0.35 (higher than central tau=0.25) will decrease correction-trigger frequency and explore the high-tau regime of the tau-sweep curve. Combined with tau=0.15 (low) and existing tau=0.25 (central), this completes the Object-suite tau-sweep and reveals whether SR varies monotonically or peaks near 0.25.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python -u src/evaluate.py --model pi05 --mode adaptive_conformal_crm --K 2 --max_correction_norm 0.2 --conformal_threshold 0.35 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_pi05_unified_3suite/crm_best.pt --obs_dim 2048 --unified_obs_dim 2088 --benchmark object --seed 42 --n_rollouts 20 --output_file logs/eval_object_adaptive_pi05_tau035_seed42.json
